title: Oil Tankers on Fire. Crude FELL 19% Anyway. #Shorts #CrudeOil #India
description:
Oil tankers caught fire at Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude fell 19% anyway — to $89/barrel.

US record production, OPEC oversupply, and China demand slowdown are overwhelming geopolitical risk.

For India: fuel price cut window open, airlines save on ATF, import bill drops ~2.5 lakh crore.

Educational content. These are market facts, not financial recommendations.
